scope: Major centralized crypto exchanges; spot trading fees shown are base/regular-tier rates where the official schedule exposed them. Fees vary by region, product, trading volume, VIP status, balances, promotions, and payment method. This spreadsheet focuses on exchange trading fees; asset-specific withdrawal/network fees are generally separate and were not enumerated unless stated.

exchanges.discounted_spot_fee: 0.075% maker / 0.075% taker when paying with BNB (regular user)
exchanges.other_fees: USDC spot standard rate for regular users: 0.095% maker/taker; BNB-discounted rate: 0.07125% maker/taker.

exchanges.fee_status: Rates are account-specific and the official fee page requires sign-in to display current rates and qualification criteria.
exchanges.fee_structure: Maker/taker rates vary by product and fee tier; spot, perpetuals/futures, and options use separate 30-day volume thresholds. Stablecoin pairs may have separate schedules.
exchanges.other_fees: The order preview displays the applicable rate; Coinbase says fees may change.

exchanges.kraken_plus_benefit: Trading fees waived on up to $10,000 monthly volume for major currencies; spreads and card-processing fees still apply. Benefit excludes Kraken Pro spot, futures, API, and OTC trades.
exchanges.other_fees: Small instant trades can carry a fee of up to $2 instead of the 1% fee; small-balance conversions below minimum order size carry a fixed 3% fee.

exchanges.fee_basis: Regular user; 0–$100,000 assets or 0–$100,000 30-day trading volume
exchanges.fee_tier_method: Tiers are based on assets under management and 30-day trading volume and are updated daily.

exchanges.fee_basis: Non-VIP user; all spot trading pairs
exchanges.other_fees: Actual rates vary by VIP level and region; unfilled or cancelled order portions incur no trading fee.

exchanges.cro_benefit: With qualifying CRO balance at Level 1: 0% maker and 0.4400% taker (12% off).
exchanges.other_fees: Trading fee rates are updated daily at 04:00 UTC; forced liquidation fee is 0.5%.

exchanges.fee_basis: Standard spot fee; under $10,000 USD volume
Lowest tier; $0 trailing 30-day volume and $0 asset balance
exchanges.fee_tier_method: Tier is based on trailing 30-day trading volume or USD asset balance; the higher qualifying tier determines the lower fee.

exchanges.fee_basis: Base spot pairs identified by KuCoin as 0.1% maker and 0.1% taker; exact rate varies by pair and user fee level
exchanges.fee_tier_method: Trading fee level, maker/taker status, and optional KCS fee payment affect the final rate; some pairs do not use the 0.1%/0.1% base rate.

exchanges.fee_basis: Standard spot tier before VIP/BGB discounts
exchanges.other_fees: Crypto deposits have no Bitget fee; withdrawal fees vary by cryptocurrency and network and are shown before confirmation. VIP and BGB discounts may reduce trading fees.
